status: frozen before any group ranking; researcher-defined illustrative transfer, not elicited policy

common.reference: all scored cases in the current population/view
common.exposure: case count only; never monetary cost

ocel.unit: purchase_order object; unique event ID counted once per directly related PO
ocel.projection: direct event-object relationships only; no traversal of object-object links
ocel.groups: initial declared vendor metadata; purchasing group is alternative context

criteria.name: Long observed PO approval lag
criteria.evidence: first creation and first approval recorded, timestamps valid, nonnegative lag

criteria.name: Goods receipt recorded before PO approval
criteria.evidence: first goods receipt and first approval recorded

criteria.name: Repeated execution of a linked payment object
criteria.evidence: at least one directly linked payment execution with an extant payment object
criteria.unit: max distinct execution events per linked payment object

criteria.name: Long first PO-to-payment elapsed time
criteria.evidence: first creation and first directly linked payment recorded; nonnegative lag

ocel.limits: Simulation; repeated executions are recorded patterns, not recovered loss. Shared events can affect several PO assessments. Unknown observation closure; missing endpoints stay unevaluable. Initial attributes are grouping metadata, not reconstructed time-varying truth.

icpm.unit: union of Purchase Orders and Purchase Order Activities document+item keys; source row is event-record identity
icpm.projection: raw PO activity rows only; master table left join; orphan activity cases retained with unknown master context
icpm.groups: Vendor ID and Vendor Country; missing master context forms explicit group; SKU alternative

criteria.name: Snapshot confirmation later than snapshot scheduled date
criteria.scope: all except known deletion flag L

criteria.name: First observed goods receipt later than snapshot scheduled date
criteria.scope: all except known deletion flag L
criteria.evidence: first goods receipt timestamp and snapshot scheduled date parse
criteria.unit: days, timestamps normalised to calendar date

criteria.name: Delivery-date changes recorded
criteria.evidence: at least one activity row for case

criteria.name: PO quantity changes recorded
criteria.evidence: at least one activity row for case

criteria.name: Snapshot confirmed quantity below ordered quantity
criteria.evidence: order quantity finite positive; confirmed quantity finite nonnegative

icpm.limits: Snapshot dates can differ from historical commitments; first receipt is not completed fulfilment. Exact repeated rows may be real repeated observations, retained primary. No completion-absence claim, no matched invoice/receipt quantity balance, no actual cost or currency inference from indexed values.
